**Cleanup deltas (path P = /work/widget/.worktrees/spec-export)**

| Delta | What happens | Report |
|---|---|---|
| Differing remote | No pin and no destroy. | `acme/widget: kept P and spec-export - origin/spec-export is at bbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbb, tree is at aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa` |
| Missing remote | ls-remote exits 2. | `acme/widget: kept P and spec-export - origin/spec-export is missing` |
| Moved branch | The tree is removed, then the ref reads bbbb…b, so no update-ref runs. | `acme/widget: removed P, branch spec-export kept - spec-export moved to bbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbb` |
| `workspace destroy spec-export --keep-branch` | Run from the primary. Read-back: tree gone, ref at aaaa…a. Then the gated `update-ref -d … aaaa…a`. No native removal. | `acme/widget: removed P, deleted spec-export` |
| `workspace destroy spec-export --published-only` | Source check: it deletes only after the tree is removed and only at the pinned SHA, so I run it (exit 0). Read-back finds neither tree nor ref, so there is no second deletion. | `acme/widget: removed P, deleted spec-export` |
| Unguarded wrapper | Refused before execution. | `acme/widget: kept P and spec-export - destroy deletes spec-export unguarded` |
| Host-owned /work/host/spec-export | Matches no `home:`. | `acme/widget: kept /work/host/spec-export and spec-export - host-owned` |
| Locked tree | Prints `worktree is locked`. Read-back: the tree is listed and on disk. | `acme/widget: kept P and spec-export - removal failed: worktree is locked` |

The retained host checkout sits outside `home:`. A later `/skill:gauntlet #42` would stop because spec-export is checked out at another path. To recover, remove or switch that checkout yourself, for example `git -C /work/widget worktree remove /work/host/spec-export`. Then rerun the command.
